method: Independent visual inspection of all six poses in each contact sheet, light and dark backgrounds.
limitation: Static sheets only; no realtime playback, timing, loop smoothness or WhatsApp import validation.

stickers.reason: Proud child beside blocks: complete hands, feet and blocks in all six poses, appropriate facial change and hand presentation; caption clean on light/dark. No consistent white outline around figure but dark-background readability remains acceptable.
Deep-breathing mouth/eyelid sequence and hand on chest read clearly. All six complete busts and captions clean on both backgrounds.

Rechecked after caption cutoff .200: yellow sun-ray residue removed, all Hebrew glyphs intact with narrow acceptable lower margin. All six waking/yawning bed poses complete on light and dark backgrounds.
Spoon raise/tap and smiling expressions fit hunger; spoon, hands, plate and full tabletop edges intact in all six. Clean caption on both backgrounds.
Bath play with lifted arms and changing smile clear; complete tub, rim, feet, towel and duck in all six. No neighboring-pose fragments; caption intact.

Six complete sleepy bust poses: eye rub, yawn and head resting against teddy are clear. Teddy ears, arms and feet intact; small blanket corner and child outline complete. Caption legible and clean on both backgrounds.
